notes.title: Gal*Gun VR Update (Build 2075675)
notes.content:
* A bug where the classroom menu would become unresponsive has been fixed.
* A bug where changing the handedness in the options would not change the trigger controls appropriately has been fixed.
* A bug where restarting a stage would cause an incorrect number of Mini Kuronas to be displayed in the results has been fixed.
* A bug where a dizzy Mini Kurona would immediately posess a girl upon contact has been fixed.
* A bug where Mini Kuronas would get stuck on walls or other obstacles has been fixed.
* A bug where girls would begin moving while still in a waiting state has been fixed.
* A bug where a stealth wave would not advance when a girl's discovery animation was interrupted has been fixed.
* When playing without VR, the game can now be controlled as normal while paused.

notes.title: Gal*Gun VR Update (Build 2054629)
notes.content:

notes.title: Gal*Gun VR Update (Build 2028231)
notes.content:
* The amount of reactions the girls can give while they are at your house/the classroom has been increased.
* Fixed a bug that was causing render scale values to be reset when calling girls to your house/the classroom has been fixed.
* Other minor bugs have also been fixed.
